sources.description: SillyTavern character-card worldbook for High School DxD RP. Contains character profiles, plot summaries, locations, systems, and items.
sources.notes: Derived from a SillyTavern character card worldbook. Contains RP-adapted content (MC-centric framing, some ST-specific mechanics). Canon accuracy is high for main cast, moderate for side characters. Contains 33 empty entries.

sources.description: Standalone SillyTavern worldbook for High School DxD. Contains character profiles, gameplay systems, locations, items, and style guidance with {{user}} slot placeholders.
sources.notes: Standalone worldbook with {{user}} placeholders for RP adaptation. Canon accuracy is moderate. Overlaps partially with dxd_card.worldbook.json.

sources.description: Wenku8 High School DxD table-of-contents crawl and comparison against current curated story index. Contains no chapter body text; used only to verify volume/short-story coverage and title mapping.
sources.notes: Confirms main volumes 1-25 and several DX/BD/EX/HERO groups are covered, but many side stories are aggregate summaries rather than independent story files.

sources.description: Wenku8 True High School DxD table-of-contents crawl. Stores TOC metadata only and verifies current curated True DxD story entries.
sources.notes: Confirms True DxD volumes 1-4 correspond to current curated stories; Wenku8 also has a short-story group not yet represented as an independent story file.

sources.description: Wenku8 SlashDog table-of-contents crawl. Stores TOC metadata only and verifies current curated SlashDog/刃狗 prequel story entries.
sources.notes: Confirms SlashDog three source volumes correspond by order to current curated prequel stories; source volume titles are generic while curated titles are descriptive.

conflicts.description: Both worldbooks contain character profiles for the same characters with slightly different framing. Where overlap exists, dxd_card.worldbook.json is treated as primary due to higher detail and entry count.
conflicts.resolution: Merged into single character entries with sourceRefs to both sources.
